VARIABLE.NAME: AkathisiaAssessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current clinician assessment of akathisia. Unresolved is an assessed differential, including psychotic agitation, not missing evidence. Subjective restlessness need not have overt movement.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=3 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: AkathisiaAntipsychoticAssociation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed medication association using timing, dose changes, reductions in EPS treatment and alternative explanations; not diagnosed by this graph.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: DoseReductionFeasible
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-assessed feasibility of antipsychotic dose reduction; no automatic dose change.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: LowerAkathisiaRiskSwitchFeasible
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-assessed feasibility of switching to an agent with lower akathisia propensity.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: PsychoticWorseningConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed concern about psychotic worsening after regimen change; absence does not remove monitoring requirements.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: AkathisiaTreatmentPreferenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Patient expresses a concern about options or tradeoffs; absence does not establish consent.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-identified current urgent safety concern, including suicidality; no suicide prediction or automatic causation attributed to akathisia.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: DistressOrAdherenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed distress or threatened adherence related to symptoms; retain individual findings outside this aggregate flag.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: BenzodiazepineRespiratoryConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed respiratory concern: high-dose exposure, alcohol, opioids, other sedatives or sleep apnea. Requires detailed medication review; no numerical threshold supplied.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: BenzodiazepineFallsCognitiveConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed vulnerability to somnolence, cognitive effects, coordination impairment or falls, including older patients.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: BenzodiazepineMisuseConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed misuse or substance-use-disorder vulnerability, including current or past alcohol or other substance use disorder.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: PropranololBloodPressureConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed blood-pressure concern relevant to propranolol; not a complete contraindication screen.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: PropranololExposureConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed interaction or food-related exposure concern; source names CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 and protein-rich food effects. No dose adjustment inferred.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after dependence and measurement review

VARIABLE.NAME: AkathisiaIndicationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Review indication before attributing agitation to psychosis or changing antipsychotic treatment.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: AkathisiaAntipsychoticRegimenReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Discuss feasible regimen changes and psychosis tradeoff. All changes need monitoring; a concern is not a veto.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: AdjunctDiscussion
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Discuss benzodiazepine and beta-blocker options alongside regimen changes; no ranking or mutually exclusive treatment choice.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Urgent safety review remains independent of established medication association; routine state never rules out suicide risk.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: BurdenReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Review distress and adherence even when the symptom differential remains unresolved.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: BenzodiazepineSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Parallel safety topic, not permission to prescribe; each respiratory, falls/cognitive and misuse concern remains separately visible.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement

VARIABLE.NAME: PropranololSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Parallel blood pressure and exposure review; monitor blood pressure with dose increases regardless of concern state. Full safety screening is external.
discretization=Author-proposed categories; operational criteria require clinical agreement
